title: Aluminum bass, flat versus round back, amplifying the bass
summary: Foster had the first metal bass and discusses tone, flat-back basses and putting a mic on the bass.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Well, when I first asked you about the different bases, first of all, what about aluminum bases? Did you ever try one of those?
Did you like it or was it any good?
Wait a minute. Where's that big picture? See that big picture there? Show you the aluminum base. I had the first gold one. No, no, no, no, that one. The one with the whole band on it. Oh, yeah.
That's over in here. Yeah, Blue Russell. Yeah. Yeah, sure, I remember.
That's a metal base. That's a metal base.
Oh, yeah. That's a metal base. Did you like it or not?
It was good for running around the country because you never would win a war but getting banged up. Right.
I'd never pick it up. Was the tone as good?
No, on some of those. Not on your C's. On your B-flats.

On your B-flats. On your B-flats. It's very metallic. See if I got it on the way you can see it. That's better. Well, that's all right. I just wondered if you used it on it. Oh, yeah. I have one. I had every kind of base that you can remember. What kind of a base do you have now? General. It doesn't have any flat back or anything.

The whole thing is farmed, doesn't it? No. You see, the flat back is the old-style base. Flat back is the old base. Flat back is the old base. Flat back base is one of the best bases. Is that all right? Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
If you've got a good flat back base, you've got to get a base. But it's very silly when you run into one of those kind of bases. My base is round back.
See, I buy this business. It's a nice sound.

It sounds wonderful out there. Yeah, great. Oh yeah, Pat and I were talking about, my, you really play some bass. Oh, shit. You really play some bass. Oh, shit. You know. Thanks to him. Well, I was going to ask if you ever played an electric bass or tried one of those new things that look like that.

I got a mic for my bass my sister gave me, I overplays him. You know, when you play those, when you put a mic on your bass, you got to pick it very easy. I overplays it, see. I got a strong wrist and I overplay it. I said if you play, if you hit one of those basses too hard, you don't get nothing. See? You got to touch it very light. You overplay it. I said I had one and I had the boss to fix up the thing for me down there to put my mic on and overplay it. I didn't need it. And I know Stanford didn't work. Oh, you have some of my kids.
